title: 差点 Step 5 · Did It Happen? The Big Sort
description: Sorting games: first sort the events into wanted and unwanted, then sort sentence after sentence into 'happened' and 'didn't happen' — watch the 没.

points.title: Unwanted events: never happened
points.summary: Unwanted event: with or without 没, it didn't happen.
points.body:
Falling, being late, losing things, starting a quarrel …

**The whole picture: 差点 vs 差点没**

| | 😅 unwanted (摔倒) | 🎯 wanted (赶上) |
|---|---|---|
| **差点** | didn't happen | didn't happen 😢 |
| **差点没** | didn't happen (same!) | **did** happen 🎉 |

**Two questions decide it**
1. Is the event something the speaker **wants** (赶上, 考上, 买到) or **doesn't want** (摔倒, 迟到, 丢)?
2. Unwanted → it **didn't happen**, with or without 没. Wanted → 差点 = didn't happen, 差点没 = **did** happen.

**Memory hooks**
- 坏事加「没」，意思不变 — for bad things, 没 changes nothing.
- 好事加「没」，意思反转 — for good things, 没 flips it.

**Mood words give it away**
- Relief (it went well): **幸亏 / 还好 / 好在** (luckily), **总算** (in the end), **好险** (that was close!)
- Regret (it didn't): **可惜** (what a pity), **就差一点** (just a tiny bit short), **真遗憾** (what a shame)

points.summary: Wanted event: 差点 = didn't happen (so close!), 差点没 = did happen (phew!).

notes: Getting into university: wanted.

questions.prompt: Who got what they wanted? Select **everyone** who did.
questions.explanation: Wanted things: **差点没 = got it**, 差点 = missed it.
notes: Plain 差点 → no ticket.
Wanted + 差点没 → I **got** a ticket.
Wanted + 差点没 → she **won**, just.
差点就…了 + wanted → he **didn't** get in.
Wanted + 差点没 → he **got in**, just.
Plain 差点 + wanted → so close, she **didn't** win.

questions.prompt: Which of these things **actually happened**? Select all of them.
questions.explanation: The trap: 差点**没** + unwanted looks negative-negative, but it's just 'almost' — **nothing happened**.
notes: No 差点 — he really fell.
😅 Being late is unwanted → 差点 and 差点没 both mean it **didn't happen**.
No 差点 — the child really cried.
No 差点 — you were really late.
